QuestInfo.name: Checking on Ludibrium
QuestInfo.0: Athena Pierce has a request for you.
QuestInfo.1: You must prepare for the Black Mage's imminent return. \r\nMeet Marcel in Ludibrium to see how things are going there.
QuestInfo.2: Marcel says that Black Mage wouldn't attack a kids' town...

0.0: Thank you for checking on Kerning City. Will you check on the citizens of #bLudibrium#k next?

yes.0: Ludibrium is an important position. Check with #bMarcel#k to ensure nothing out of the ordinary is going on.

1.1: What are you talking about? Ludibrium's great! It's as peaceful as always. You can report THAT back to Athena Pierce.

yes.0: C'mon, have you seen this place? It's designed for kids! The Black Mage isn't going to destroy a children's playground... right?

npc.0: Ludibrium is an important position. Check with #bMarcel#k to ensure nothing out of the ordinary is going on.
